title: 第49章 你怎么就知道打架？

第49章 你怎么就知道打架？-《全民饥荒：SSS级天赋酿酒师》

上一章

存书签

下一章

许默也笑了，笑方芸。

“你怎么就知道打架？”

说完把苔藓里剩下的部分小心地栽进几个浅泥坑里，浇上河水，施了鸟粪肥，放在树屋的阴凉处。

“先养着，看看能不能繁殖。要是能行，咱们以后不缺灯了。”

方芸在一旁擦手，眼睛却盯着工作台上剩下的那几枚腐血果。

“该试那个了。”

许默点点头，将几个陶罐与塑料皮管拼接，架设出一套勉强能用的简易蒸馏器。

那五枚犹如心脏般搏动的腐血果被小心翼翼地推入器皿中。

“可以用营地能量了，但切记，火候，压住。”

方芸双手悬停在陶罐底部，借由营地篝火提取的灼热。

温度急剧飙升。

果实表面的黑色脉络不断蠕动，果皮开始不安地膨胀。

“温度失控了！退！”

许默一把拉开方芸，几乎同时，陶罐里传来一声闷响，一股浓烈的刺鼻气味猛地冲出来。

两人被熏得头昏脑涨，眼前的景象开始扭曲，石壁起伏，已经是一片幻象。

许默用力咬了一下舌尖，疼痛让他清醒过来。

他赶紧把陶罐的盖子揭开一道缝，让气味散出去。

方芸还缓了好半天，手还一直不灵活。

许墨把她扶到床上，给她喂了点花酿，她的脸色这才好了许多。

几颗果子还在工作台上，看着就一副很难处理的样子。

许墨灵机一动，拿起果子打开天赋界面。

一颗果子，水，再加上酒曲。

获得【迷魂酒（绿色）】×2。

【效果：饮用后理智-40点，生命值-10，体力值-30。】

【特性·迷魂：饮用后使一阶以下生物陷入深度昏睡，持续90秒。若涂抹在密闭空间内加热挥发，可使范围内生物产生强烈幻觉。】

【警告：该液体易燃，遇明火将剧烈燃烧并产生爆炸。】

“迷魂酒……”

方芸揉了揉太阳穴，刚才那一下差点让她产生幻觉。

“这东西能让人做梦？”

许默小心地把两瓶发酵液装进瓶里。

“做梦是轻的。”

Xu Mo also smiled and laughed at Fang Yun.

"How do you know how to fight?"

After that, he carefully planted the remaining parts of the moss into several shallow mud pits, poured river water, applied guano fertilizer, and placed them in the shade of the tree house.

"Keep it first to see if it can reproduce. If it works, we won't be short of lights in the future."

Fang Yun was wiping her hands aside, but her eyes were fixed on the few rotten blood fruits left on the workbench.

"Time to try that one."

Xu Mo nodded, spliced several clay pots and plastic pipes together, and set up a simple still that was barely usable.

The five rotten blood fruits that beat like a heart were carefully pushed into the vessel.

"You can use the energy of the camp, but remember to keep the fire under control."

Fang Yun hovered her hands at the bottom of the clay pot, absorbing the scorching heat from the campfire.

The temperature soared.

The black veins on the surface of the fruit continue to squirm, and the peel begins to swell restlessly.

"The temperature is out of control! Back off!"

Xu Mo pulled Fang Yun away, and almost at the same time, there was a muffled sound from the clay pot, and a strong pungent smell rushed out.

The two of them were so dizzy from the smoke that the scene in front of them began to distort, the stone walls undulated, and it was already an illusion.

Xu Mo bit the tip of his tongue hard, and the pain woke him up.

He quickly opened the lid of the clay pot a crack to let the smell escape.

Fang Yun took it easy for a long time, and her hands were still not flexible.

Xu Mo helped her to the bed and fed her some flower wine, and her complexion improved a lot.

A few fruits were still on the workbench, looking like they were difficult to handle.

Xu Mo had an idea, picked up the fruit and opened the talent interface.

A fruit, water, and distiller’s yeast.

Obtain [Ecstasy Wine (Green)] × 2.

[Effect: After drinking, sanity -40 points, health value -10, physical strength -30 points.】

[Characteristics·Ecstasy: After drinking, creatures below level one will fall into a deep coma, lasting 90 seconds.If applied in a closed space and heated to evaporate, it can cause strong hallucinations in creatures within the range.】

[Warning: This liquid is flammable and will burn violently and explode when exposed to open flames.】

"Ecstasy wine..."

Fang Yun rubbed her temples, which almost caused her to hallucinate.

"This thing can make people dream?"

Xu Mo carefully put two bottles of fermentation liquid into the bottles.

"Dreaming is light."
